name: Everything deck
description: The reference deck: every catalog layout, every block type and every chart family, with steps on every prop kind, a media background, an explorable table and chart, a poll, a calculator and an embedded app. Fictional Orbit Lane data.

style.footer: Orbit Lane · everything deck · fictional figures

slides.title: Everything deck

props.title: Everything a deck can do
props.subtitle: Every layout, block family and chart family in one reference deck
props.meta: Orbit Lane · fictional figures · reference deck

slides.notes: This deck is the reference to copy from: every catalog layout, every block type and every chart family, with fictional Orbit Lane data.

slides.title: Layouts
slides.notes: A section divider over a local media background: a base64 PNG with a dark scrim so the title keeps its contrast.

slides.title: Text blocks

blocks.markdown: Orbit Lane ships **weekly**. Every release is _small_ and reviewed.

slides.notes: Heading, text and a list; the list is a stepped block (`step` on the block itself) and fades up on the first step.

slides.title: Two-column split

left.heading: Before
left.body: Orbit Lane shipped one release a quarter.

slides.notes: Both columns are stepped props (`left`, then `right`): press next twice to build the before and after comparison.

slides.title: Quote, callout, divider
slides.notes: A quote block, a labelled divider and a callout that arrives on the first step.

slides.title: Three column cards

cards.heading: Speed
cards.body: Ship the smallest valuable thing first.

slides.notes: Cards two and three reveal one per step through `cards.*` markers; the first card is on screen from the start.

slides.title: Media blocks

columns.alt: A blue gradient standing in for a chart
columns.caption: Figure 1

slides.notes: Image and video blocks side by side in a columns block; both sources are local data URIs, never remote.

props.title: Layout: image-left

image.alt: A blue gradient standing in for a diagram

props.heading: The release train
props.body: Each car is one reviewed change.

slides.notes: The image pane on the left reveals on the first step through an `image` marker.

slides.title: People and stats
slides.notes: A people grid and a stat row; the stats arrive on the first step.

slides.title: image-right

props.title: Layout: image-right

image.alt: A blue gradient standing in for a diagram

props.heading: Lead with the idea
props.body: Then anchor it with the picture.

slides.notes: Same layout, mirrored: the text leads and the image on the right stays put.

slides.title: Interactive table
slides.notes: An explorable table: viewers sort by a column, filter rows and highlight one. Clicks inside it never advance the deck.

slides.title: image-centered

image.alt: A blue gradient standing in for a diagram

slides.notes: A centered image with a caption; the picture is a locally generated PNG, never a remote URL.

spec.title: Weekly releases

spec.title: Reviewed changes
spec.description: Reviewed changes: a fictional series for the area chart family.

slides.title: image-full-bleed

props.caption: Full bleed with a dark overlay

spec.title: Release types

spec.title: Review time
spec.description: Review time: a fictional series for the pie chart family.

slides.notes: Part-to-whole families: a donut and a pie chart, each with three fictional slices.

slides.title: Quote

props.quote: Ship small, review everything, and keep the deck honest.

slides.notes: A marker on the props object itself (path ``) hides the whole quote until the first step; the background stays.

slides.title: Funnel and explorable chart

spec.title: Release funnel
spec.description: Release funnel: a fictional series for the funnel chart family.

spec.title: Releases by team
spec.description: Platform ships the most releases; switch the chart kind or hide a team.

slides.notes: The funnel family, and an explorable chart: viewers switch its kind, hide a series and narrow the range.

slides.title: Code with callout

code.source:
const ready = checks.every((check) => check.ok);
if (ready) publish('weekly');

slides.notes: The code pane carries a `code` step marker; its highlights move per line as you step through.

slides.title: Code and terminal

lines.text: # create a deck from a brief (fictional example)
pnpm protoyard quick "a deck about our launch"

slides.notes: A code block with line numbers and highlights, and a terminal transcript of a fictional command.

slides.title: Timeline and steps blocks
slides.notes: The timeline and steps blocks; the steps block arrives on the first step.

slides.title: Comparison table
slides.notes: Rows two and three reveal through `rows.*` markers, so the comparison builds one argument at a time.

slides.title: Comparison and cards blocks
slides.notes: A comparison block with a highlighted column, and three cards with icons, links and an avatar image.

slides.title: Process steps
slides.notes: Each process step after the first is a `steps.*` marker; walk the audience through branch, review, check and ship.

slides.title: Icon, call to action and columns

blocks.text: Icon, call to action and columns

slides.notes: An icon, a nested columns block and a call-to-action block with two actions.

slides.title: Timeline
slides.notes: Timeline events reveal through `events.*` markers; the last one fades up to close the story.

slides.title: Tabs and reveal
slides.notes: Tabs switch panels and the reveal hides an answer until asked; both keep their own keys and clicks.

slides.title: Team avatars
slides.notes: People use library avatars (fictional portraits). Two of them arrive together on the first step through `people.*` markers.

slides.title: Blocks
slides.notes: A divider on a gradient background preset. Next come the interactive blocks: vote, answer, calculate and start an app.

slides.title: Poll and quiz

columns.question: Which feature do you use most?

slides.notes: A poll and a quiz. Votes and answers stay in this browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

slides.title: video-centered
slides.notes: A centered video stays muted; the video pane reveals through a `video` marker.

slides.title: Calculator and counter
slides.notes: A what-if calculator with a slider and a counter; both recompute live, in integer cents where money is involved.

slides.title: Form
slides.notes: A form block; responses are simulated and stored locally, never emailed.

slides.title: video-right

props.title: Layout: video-right

slides.notes: Video on the right; same muted clip, mirrored layout for variety.

slides.title: Map
slides.notes: A map on the simulated Port Meridian basemap: fictional places, no tile server.

slides.title: Chart layout

spec.title: Releases per quarter, fictional
spec.description: Releases grew from 3 to 13 a quarter as the team moved to weekly shipping.

slides.notes: The chart layout with its data table; the whole `spec` is a stepped prop. Markers inside a series would not hide, so there are none.

slides.title: Embedded app
slides.notes: An embedded app: a tiny tracker blueprint that starts inside the slide when the viewer presses Open demo.

slides.title: Flow diagram
slides.notes: A flow diagram with a loop back: brief, blueprint, prototype and feedback.

slides.title: Big stat

props.label: weekly releases in a fictional year

slides.notes: One number, said out loud: fifty-two releases. Pause and let it land before moving on.

slides.title: Tree diagram
slides.notes: A file tree of a fictional prototype; the accent node marks the app entry.

slides.title: Board
slides.notes: A board with three columns and cards; drag is not needed to read it.

props.title: Copy what you need
props.text: Every slide here is a recipe: open it with deck inspect.
